MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Northwind Analytics Ltd., a company registered in England ("Client") and Harbor Pixel Studio LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Contractor").

1. Services
1.1 The Contractor shall provide the design and development services described in each Statement of Work.
1.2 The Contractor shall deliver monthly progress reports to the Client no later than the fifth business day of each month.

2. Term and Renewal
2.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for a period of twelve (12) months.
2.2 This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month periods unless either party gives ninety (90) days' prior written notice of non-renewal.

3. Fees and Payment
3.1 The Client shall pay the Contractor a monthly fee of USD 12,500.
3.2 The Client shall pay each invoice within sixty (60) days of receipt of the invoice.
3.3 Overdue amounts shall accrue interest at 2% per month until paid.
3.4 The Contractor may increase its fees at any time upon written notice to the Client.

4. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party. These obligations survive indefinitely.

5. Intellectual Property
The Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all right, title and interest in all deliverables and any pre-existing materials incorporated into the deliverables.

6. Limitation of Liability
The Contractor's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited liability for any breach.

7. Indemnification
The Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client against any and all claims, losses and damages arising out of the Services, regardless of cause.

8. Termination
8.1 The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time for convenience upon fifteen (15) days' written notice.
8.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach that is not cured within thirty (30) days.

9. Non-Compete
During the term and for twenty-four (24) months thereafter, the Contractor shall not engage in any business that competes with the Client worldwide.

10. Data Protection
The Contractor shall process customer personal data only on the Client's documented instructions and in accordance with the GDPR.

11. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of London shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
